spanish: Y harás el candelabro de oro puro; a martillo será hecho el candelabro; su muslo y su caña, sus cálices, sus bulbos y sus flores, desde él serán.

findings.issue: The first lampstand is an indefinite construct (no article); “el” marks it definite. The article is licensed only on the second lampstand.
מִקְשָׁה is a noun of beaten work; “a martillo” turns it into an instrumental phrase that names the hammer.
גָּבִיעַ is a cup or bowl; “cálices” narrows it toward a liturgical chalice or a botanical calyx.

notes: Person, number, stem, conjunctions, and the part-list match the tokens; tú future matches 2ms.
